result.summary: This residential intersection lacks all basic pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. Pedestrians are forced to navigate uncontrolled crossings where sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the corners.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection corners creates a significant barrier for people with mobility impairments, strollers, or carts.
hazards.location_in_image: All visible sidewalk corners at the intersection

hazards.name: Uncontrolled intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to manage the right-of-way between vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parking
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Street corners along the curb line

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Install concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly designate pedestrian space and alert drivers to crossing locations.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.
